# RegEx

Test regular expressions with RE2 or regexp2 (.NET: lookaround, backreferences).

Category: Testers · ID: `regex` · Search terms: regexp, regular, expression, match, re2, grep, pcre, dotnet, lookahead

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui regex [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Text

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pattern` | text | `` | Pattern. |
| `--engine` | `re2`, `regexp2` | `re2` | Engine. re2: Go's linear-time engine; regexp2: .NET syntax with lookaround and backreferences (1 s limit per match) |
| `--ignore-case` | on/off | `false` | i. Ignore case |
| `--multiline` | on/off | `false` | m. ^ and $ per line |
| `--dotall` | on/off | `false` | s. . matches \n |
